lead: Ilhan Omar is a widely followed American politician, born on 4 October 1982 in Mogadishu.
As of 2026, she is 43 years old, and her birth date places her under the Libra sign.
She is associated with work such as This is What America Looks Like and has held the office of member of the Minnesota House of Representatives and United States representative.

sections.heading: Ilhan Omar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ilhan Omar was born on 4 October 1982 in Mogadishu, and holds American nationality.
Public records name her father, Nur Omar Mohamed. She is a sibling of Sahra Noor.
She received her education at Edison High School and North Dakota State University.
She is recorded as speaking English and Somali.

sections.heading: Ilhan Omar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician, political staffer, civil servant, women's rights activist, policy advisor and writer as her occupations, including work with Minnesota Department of Education.
Among the credits most often linked to Ilhan are This is What America Looks Like.

She has held the following offices: member of the Minnesota House of Representatives (2017–2019), United States representative (2019–2021), United States representative (2021–2023) and United States representative (2023–present). She is affiliated with Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party.
